title: IpnsPublisher advisory lock never released after successful publish
description: ipns_publisher.rs IpnsPublisher::can_publish acquires pg_try_advisory_lock(IPNS_ADVISORY_LOCK_ID) but there is no corresponding pg_advisory_unlock call. The lock is a session-level advisory lock — it is held until the session disconnects. In a long-running process this means the first instance to successfully call can_publish holds the lock for the entire process lifetime. A second instance that starts later will never be able to publish IPNS even if the first instance's Kubo node becomes unavailable. Compare to GC which calls release_gc_lock after each run.
